run_benchmark_environment: run a learner against a stream of training and prediction events to compute benchmark metrics
create_environment_state: create an EnvironmentState dataclass to track learner state, metrics, checkpoints, and resource usage
resume_from_checkpoint: resume a benchmark run from a saved EnvironmentState checkpoint to continue processing events
define_run_result: define a RunResult NamedTuple to hold benchmark results, resource usage, and final learner state
train_on_event: train a learner on a TrainingEvent with checkpoint support and resource tracking
